comment: First-load budget for `make check-first-load-js` (scripts/perf/firstLoadJs.ts --budget), run in CI after `make build`. The totals are index.html plus its statically reachable module JS.
The check fails when first-load brotli bytes grow more than 2% over brBytes, or raw bytes more than 100 KiB over rawBytes.
A smaller first load never fails, so a PR that shrinks it needs no update here.
If a PR grows the first load on purpose, the perf owner updates the recorded value in that same PR.
Recorded from a clean `make build` of main ea19a44101 with Bun 1.3.12.
